case_studies.author: Callista Arden
case_studies.number_label: reviews, from a start of about 70 sales
case_studies.start: A new author with about 70 sales, mostly from friends and family, and no experience of book marketing.
case_studies.work: We placed the book in email promotions and reader newsletters suited to its audience. When the first campaign worked, we ran it again.
case_studies.result: The book reached 560 reviews after the first campaign, and 1,800 reviews after the second.

case_studies.author: Kit Rose
case_studies.start: A published book with fewer than 30 reviews.
case_studies.work: We found book clubs and reading groups suited to the book, introduced it to their organisers and coordinated the discussions.
case_studies.result: The book went from under 30 reviews to more than 200 within two months.

case_studies.author: Christina Rozelle
case_studies.start: A published book that was not reaching the readers it was written for.
case_studies.work: We audited and fixed the book’s Amazon listing, then promoted it to readers on Goodreads.
case_studies.result: The book sold more than 90 copies in a single month.
